accounting_interpretation.envelope_scope: The unchanged new-card rule is8eps selected-local element contribution L1. accounting_interpretation.phase: Old saved physical-face owners arethird_medium; this card did not decode solid and does not establish the phase of corner_only cells10371/10408.
accounting_interpretation.discrete_vs_physical: Owner support is the volume integral of material P against selected Q1 basis gradients, while PTRACE is an independent boundary line estimate with body-normal sign. Their difference can involve the volume/edge stress variation, other cell faces, material Div(P), stress jumps and discrete quadrature. This run only locates the saved support discrepancy; it does not independently evaluate or separate those continuum terms.
